## User problem

What problem would this solve, and who experiences it?

## Proposed public API or behavior

Describe the smallest user-facing change. Include an example only with synthetic data.

## Compatibility impact

Which Node.js, Express, NestJS, ESM, CommonJS, or TypeScript consumers could be affected?

## Security and privacy impact

Could this change collect, retain, redact, or transmit new data? Do not include tokens, private
keys, production URLs, customer payloads, or proprietary source.

## Performance impact

Could this add synchronous work, memory, queue pressure, dependencies, or network activity?

## Alternatives

What alternatives or workarounds did you consider?
